title: Grateful Dead Live at Newcastle City Hall on 1972-04-11
source: remastered by Bill Giles - source is SBD MC>D>CD>SoundForge>CDSee info file for flaws & Bill's mastering notes

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording is clear enough with a touch of muddiness, while the show delivers smoking Good Lovin', an epic Other One (with a hidden Feelin’ Groovy jam) and a fiery Truckin'‑Other One sequence.
ai_review.review: The gig is praised for its tight first set, psychedelic early‑‘72 PITB, and a second set that builds into a scorching Truckin' > The Other One with a surprise Feelin’ Groovy jam.  Recording quality is generally good – soundboard source with occasional muddiness – making the performance very listenable despite a few vocal slip‑ups on Jack Straw.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate 4–5 stars, highlighting strong musical moments; recording is described as good with minor flaws, yielding an overall high‑average combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear soundboard source praised as "very good" by several reviewers, though some note a slight muddiness at the start and occasional track‑order issues in the download.

standout_songs: The Other One (with Feelin' Groovy jam)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Tight first set with a short, psychedelic PITB; second set builds momentum through an intense Truckin' > Other One and finishes with strong encores.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocals on Jack Straw are thin (possibly due to smacking up), but his guitar work is praised – bittersweet slide, explosive chords on Greatest Story Ever Told, and overall strong playing.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for beautiful harmonies, "tight" bass lines, and a Miles‑Davis‑style quote during the Truckin' jam; generally called a "bomb" by reviewers.
band_member_comments.Bob: Provides pedal‑steel flavor on Looks Like Rain and sings lead on Jack Straw; his rhythm work is described as explosive in the first set.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drummer praised as "one drummer rules" with intense, driving performance especially on Truckin' and The Other One.
